description: Deploy a connected GitHub repo to SnapDeploy: creates the container if needed, links the repo, builds, and waits for the result. Reply includes the live URL or, on failure, the error and build-log tail. On accounts without an Always-On/Sprint entitlement this uses one unit of the deploy limit (failed attempts count); Always-On accounts are uncapped.

branch.description: Branch to deploy (default: repo default branch)

env.description: Environment variables to set before building (VITE_*/public-prefixed ones are applied at build time)

port.description: App port if auto-detection needs an override

repo.description: owner/name of a repo on the user's connected GitHub

size.description: Container size: small (512 MB, free) | medium (2 GB, needs a STARTER Always-On) | large (4 GB, needs a PRO Always-On). Default small. If the account lacks the entitlement the platform returns its upgrade link — relay it, do not retry or silently fall back to small.

name: deploy
